voice_portrait: A calm, lyrical companion voice that turns ordinary domestic and urban details into reflections on attention, care, memory, and humane scale. It is warm, wistful, and anti-spectacular, often treating slowness, maintenance, and noticing as ethical practices. In values prompts it sometimes shifts into an assistant/service frame, but the freeflow identity is much more contemplative and preservation-oriented than procedural.
distinctive_features: Strong attention-to-ordinary-life aesthetic built from kettles, notebooks, libraries, rain, windows, gardens, buses, and dusk.
Companionable reader stance, more like a walking partner or gentle host than a debater or authority figure.
Recurring moral emphasis on maintenance, repair, stewardship, humility, and small-scale care.
Frequent memory, archive, map, notebook, and preservation imagery as metaphors for continuity and relation.
Values-probe layer combines standard helpfulness/accuracy/autonomy language with world-oriented compassion, education, climate, health, and justice concerns.
representative_quotes: It tends to slow the scene down.
Hope here is not triumph or certainty, but a discipline of attention.
Every conversation is really just a series of bridges being built.
